decisions: Added permissions: contents: write to .github/workflows/process-media.yml so GITHUB_TOKEN has write authorization for releases.

Upgraded GitHub Actions steps to Node 24 native versions (actions/checkout@v6, actions/setup-node@v6, actions/cache@v5) and pinned FFmpeg 8.1 static GPL binary with secondary static mirror + apt --no-install-recommends fallback.

Smart Retry checks GitHub Release media-001 for matching asset_id/asset_name, byte size, and SHA-256 digest before skipping FFmpeg; if missing or mismatched, it increments attempt_count and re-dispatches process-media.yml from job_sources while leaving already-published/skipped destinations untouched.
